WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.raceId,
    c.country,
    SUM(cr.points) as points_sum,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  gd.raceId,
  gd.country,
  gd.points_sum,
  gd.count,
  gd.count - ac.avg_count as count_minus_average
FROM grouped_data gd
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE gd.count > ac.avg_count
ORDER BY count_minus_average DESC
LIMIT 10
